summary: Live Oak Bancshares filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of depositary shares, each representing a 1/40th interest in a share of Fixed Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series B, with a $25 per depositary share liquidation preference ($1,000 per preferred share). Dividends are non-cumulative, payable quarterly beginning December 15, 2026, when and if declared. The filing is a routine bank regulatory-capital shelf takedown, not a return-of-capital event; the bank intends to list the depositary shares on the NYSE under LOB/PB. Terms such as price, coupon, and size are left blank.
